aaa_enabled.summary: Configure AAA authentication login for default access methods.
aaa_enabled.notes: Ensure local fallback or local admin credentials are set to prevent lockout.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Disable Telnet access server on all configured VRFs.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Telnet transmits passwords in cleartext. SSH should be used exclusively.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Configure the global session idle timeout limit to 10 minutes or less.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: The parameter is in minutes. 10 minutes = 600 seconds.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Configure local admin credentials with secure default hashing.
cli: user admin group administrators password plaintext <strong-password>
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: AOS-CX automatically encrypts and hashes all stored user passwords.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove default community strings public and private.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Replace default public/private community names with unique, random values.

http_server_disabled.summary: HTTP web server is unsupported on AOS-CX; no disable command is required.
http_server_disabled.notes: AOS-CX only runs HTTPS server for Web UI and REST API management.

ssh_version_2.summary: AOS-CX enforces SSH version 2.0 by default. Verify status with 'show ssh server'.
ssh_version_2.notes: SSHv1 is not supported by AOS-CX SSH server software.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure a remote syslog server destination.
logging_enabled.notes: Logging to a remote collector ensures logs are preserved when local buffers rotate.

management_acl.summary: Configure an SSH server allow-list to restrict management access.
management_acl.notes: SSH allow-list restricts access on all configured VRFs.

login_banner.summary: Configure a login message of the day (MOTD) banner warning unauthorized users.
login_banner.notes: Use a non-whitespace delimiter character (like '^') to enclose the banner text.

password_min_length.summary: Enable password complexity and set the minimum local password length to 8.
password_min_length.notes: Complexity settings apply to passwords created or modified after complexity is enabled.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure a remote NTP server and enable the NTP client.
ntp_configured.notes: Clock synchronization is required for correct log timestamping.

no_write_snmp_community.summary: Ensure all configured SNMP communities restrict access to read-only.
no_write_snmp_community.notes: AOS-CX communities default to read-only access-level.
